summary: Posio is a self-hosted geography multiplayer game. It provides an interactive platform where participants can test and challenge their mapping knowledge against others in real time.
goodFor: It suits small groups or casual self-hosters looking for a lightweight, entertaining web activity to run on a local network or private server.
watchOut: The project lacks recent tagged releases and shows very low maintenance activity, which means you may encounter unresolved bugs or security vulnerabilities without official support.
deployNotes: As a Python application, it will typically require a WSGI or ASGI server, a reverse proxy such as Nginx to handle TLS termination, and a process manager like systemd to keep the service running reliably.
